subtitle: 낭만 뉴비 파티에 난입한 오리 공대장

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
폐광 퀘스트 재밌다!
천천히 읽으면서 돌자~
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle three-quarter shot of a cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic scene on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Orc Warrior with her weapon sheathed on her back holds open a cute chibi rolled parchment quest scroll, beaming excitedly alongside the Tauren Druid on the right who leans in happily. Minimal pale stone mine floor shadow beneath their feet.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
뭘 구경하고 있어?
길 뚫었으니 막보만 잡자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic over-the-shoulder shot from behind the startled Orc Warrior in the right foreground looking at the Skyborne Mage in the left midground, pure #FFFFFF background. With her staff sheathed on her back, the Skyborne Mage smugly dusts her hands beside a cute 2.5-head chibi SD iron cannon puffing cartoon smoke in front of a blasted-open chibi wooden mine gate.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
글 읽는 건 시간 낭비야!
전사 말고 법사나 성기사 해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Skyborne Mage with her staff sheathed leans forward smugly, raising one lecturing finger with half-closed eyes, while on the right the Orc Warrior clutches her quest scroll with an annoyed frown and a sweatdrop. Minimal ground shadow only.

Dramatic extreme bust-up close-up filling 80% of the frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. The Orc Warrior stares forward in deadpan shock and silent rage with wide eyes, tiny pupils, a twitching eyebrow, compressed mouth, and cartoon steam puffs around her head.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
뉴비끼리 즐길 거니까
우리 파티에서 나가주세요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle confrontation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Orc Warrior with her weapon sheathed on her back points firmly toward the right edge with fierce fed-up eyes, while the Skyborne Mage on the right recoils slightly with a startled sweatdrop. Minimal ground shadow beneath them.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
왜 화내? 오리 공대장 출신이
만렙 찍으라고 도와줬는데...
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium solo shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Seated alone in the center on a tiny minimal stone step with her staff sheathed on her back, the Skyborne Mage tilts her head and spreads both palms innocently with wide clueless eyes and a puzzled sweatdrop.
